name: α-Pinene
summary: A pine-scented monoterpene profile declared in WYLD pack language.
evidence: Declared in the botanical terpene blend of 2 flavors (Kiwi, Prickly Pear). No published Wyld batch certificate quantifies it: the NY terpene panels return traces of other terpenes only, and the Arizona certificates mark terpenes Not Tested.

pubchem.description: Alpha-pinene is a pinene that is bicyclo[3.1.1]hept-2-ene substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 6 and 6 respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite.

consumer_summary.what_it_is: Alpha-pinene is a bicyclic terpene substituted by methyl groups, acting as a highly volatile plant metabolite. It is one of the most common scent molecules in nature, giving many herbs and trees their characteristic fresh, woody aroma. You encounter it every time you walk through a pine forest, zest a lemon, or crush fresh rosemary.
consumer_summary.found_in: This molecule is abundant in everyday botanicals, including rosemary, sage, fennel, and lemon. It is also a major component of essential oils from tea tree, eucalyptus, and spruce trees.
consumer_summary.why_researchers_care: Researchers are drawn to alpha-pinene because of its broad biological activity, particularly its potential to interact with our cells to manage oxidative stress and inflammation. The strongest evidence so far comes from human observational studies (Oxford level 2b), which have mapped its presence and effects in various populations. Scientists are actively exploring how this common plant metabolite might be harnessed for everything from neuroprotection to novel antimicrobial agents.

structure_function.statement: Alpha-pinene is being studied for its ability to support cellular health by acting as an antioxidant.
structure_function.basis: This rests on 30 papers, including 4 human observational studies and 21 animal studies.

structure_function.statement: Early work points toward a role for alpha-pinene in supporting the body's natural anti-inflammatory responses.
structure_function.basis: Researchers have published 15 papers on this effect, primarily in animal models alongside some human observational data.

structure_function.statement: The molecule may support brain health and neuroprotection.
structure_function.basis: This is based on 6 studies, including human observational and animal research.

structure_function.statement: Alpha-pinene is being explored for its potential to promote calm and ease anxiety.
structure_function.basis: This rests on 4 studies conducted in animal models.

structure_function.statement: Early animal work points toward a potential role in pain relief.
structure_function.basis: Researchers have documented this in 4 animal studies.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Researchers are exploring whether alpha-pinene can influence tumor cells, particularly in T-cell tumors, and what this might mean for future therapies.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A randomized, placebo-controlled human clinical trial measuring tumor marker progression and cellular apoptosis in patients receiving alpha-pinene alongside standard care over six months.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Scientists are investigating if alpha-pinene could serve as a novel antimicrobial agent to combat resistant bacteria and fungi.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A Phase II randomized controlled trial applying a topical alpha-pinene formulation to localized skin infections, measuring bacterial load reduction over 14 days compared to a standard antibiotic cream.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Early animal work points toward a sedative effect, raising the question of whether inhaled alpha-pinene could naturally improve sleep quality.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: A randomized, double-blind human crossover trial where participants inhale alpha-pinene or a placebo before bed, using polysomnography to measure sleep latency and duration over two weeks.

hypothesized_benefits.hypothesis: Researchers are curious if the calming effects observed in animals translate to humans, potentially offering a natural way to manage daily stress.
hypothesized_benefits.study_to_test_it: The completed Phase 1 trial NCT04130633 evaluated the behavioral pharmacology of alpha-pinene alongside THC in 33 enrolled participants.

associated_conditions.relationship: Recorded as an occupational exposure hazard in industrial settings.

consumer_summary.cautions: In industrial settings where it is used as a concentrated solvent, acute exposure to alpha-pinene is recognized as an occupational hazard.
consumer_summary.evidence_at_a_glance: Best evidence so far is human observational work (Oxford 2b); most of the rest is animal and lab research.

studies.title: Behavioral Pharmacology of THC and Alpha-pinene
studies.summary: This study will evaluate the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of vaporized alpha-pinene and THC administered via inhalation.
